title: A FRAGGED RUNNER TURNS FOR GOOD
why: His note of 2026-10-12: a running pillager should turn hostile when fired on. Rounds have done that since v23.59 and near misses since v23.60, but your own frag into a pillager running for a ring set him chasing for one frame, and his low health rule sent him running again on the next. Now your frag turns him for good, the same as a round: hostile, coming for you and firing back.
now: A fleeing pillager hit by your frag now turns and fights instead of running again.
